points: Government bill 21/6134 passed on 15 October after a 20-minute debate
Interior committee cleared it on 14 October with CDU/CSU, SPD and Greens in favour, amended on when provisions take effect
BSI becomes market surveillance and notifying authority; the law sets the fine procedure
take: Germany now has the legal basis for CRA enforcement: the BSI becomes market surveillance and notifying authority for products with digital elements.
title: Bundestag: passes German law implementing the Cyber Resilience Act
